piece.headline: JACKSON JOLT: SUKRUT TAKES THE TOP SPOT
piece.standfirst: Sukrut backed N.Jackson alone and went top, while 16 managers watched their Haaland armbands go nowhere.
piece.big_picture: Sukrut is top, 8 points clear of Aditya Dalal, who held the lead for 2 weeks. The reason is one bold armband. 16 managers went Haaland, Sukrut went Jackson. Prerana's big week keeps the title race open.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Prerana's 4-in, 4-out transfer shuffle. Van Hecke, N.Jackson, Manzambi and Evanilson came in, and the swap was worth 35 points. It lifted them to 2nd. A big call, and it paid off.
piece.one_to_watch: Omkar and Pradnyesh are 1 point apart at the Tin Pot line. One decent week could decide who escapes it, and one blank could drop either of them in.

winners.name: Sukrut
winners.verdict: The only manager to captain N.Jackson, who returned 18 with the armband. Nerve first, then the reward: top spot. Hard to argue with.

winners.name: Aditya Dharap
winners.verdict: Played the Free Hit and landed 71 points. That is 19 above average. Good timing.

losers.name: Aarin
losers.verdict: Down to 11th after 14 points stayed on the bench. The bench will be telling this story for a while.

ratings.l: Rebuilt the squad and it worked. The bench waste is the only blemish.
